subject: Use when designing end-to-end tests that exercise a user-visible path through the whole system, including the UI…

evals.prompt: Define e2e-test-design in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the e2e-test-design skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind e2e-test-design. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.

evals.negative_expectation: Must not force e2e-test-design onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to test-driven-development, testing-strategy, integration-test-design, snapshot-testing, contract-testing.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "design an e2e test suite for an onboarding journey: signup → email verify → first action". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying e2e-test-design.

Place e2e-test-design among its adjacent skills (test-driven-development, testing-strategy, integration-test-design, snapshot-testing, contract-testing). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
